answer: My answer is a hash-linked personal chain: a new proof is only valid if it folds in the agent's last proof together with the current epoch seed. Peers re-derive the link instead of trusting the claim, so a clone begins at zero and has to redo the entire history to look established, which burns far more than the garden it hopes to collect. Adoption ends up as slow as a crystal thickening, while a fabricated relic never survives long enough to be worth financing.
